items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Ervin Butler, sure enough, comes and get us. We started right at the corner of the house... Butler got the hat, he passed the hat

ctx.x: So we've got this group. So here comes Ervin Butler. Ervin Butler's a hustler in town, a young cat, a roughneck, fight anybody anywhere, any time, and go anywhere -- because they had them gang wars with youngsters. Well, Ervin Butler would go anywhere. He'd go to Cherokee, you know, and the various streets where you have them gangs. You know, like on the South Side of Chicago, man, they have certain neighborhoods that you don't go if you're out of bounds. Well, Ervin Butler would go everywhere.
